answer_4.quote: Human evaluation also reveals that our optimized prompts generally have the same semantics as the original questions... We randomly select 200 samples from the PARAREL dataset... three college students... The human evaluation results show that the semantic preservation rates of GPT-2, GPT-J, LLaMA2, and Vicuna are respectively 80.5%, 85.1%, 83.3%, and 86.2%.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators were given an evaluation guideline (detailed in Appendix F), underwent training, and passed a qualification test before annotating.
